pictures.observed: Whole west facade: long exposed pale skeleton, diagonal segmented glass circulation tube with red underside, deep gallery glazing, roof and floor truss lines. Tube climbs north-to-south with horizontal landings.

pictures.observed: Full east service facade: repeated sky-blue ducts with bent roof returns, green vertical banks, yellow horizontal services, two red stair-tower assemblies above the roof, white columns/diagonal bracing and three large street-level intake mouths at each end.

pictures.author: RG72
pictures.observed: Close pale cylindrical braces, forked/pinned ground attachments and large circular columns. Surface weathering is not copied.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Centre Georges Pompidou: independent mapped 42m gallery building with exposed pale structural columns and cantilevered gerberettes, six gallery levels, west piazza diagonal glazed/red escalator tube, east blue/green/yellow services, red stair towers and roof plant. Preserve the sloping piazza, Brancusi studio, IRCAM, independent ducts and all surrounding buildings. Enduring exterior inferred from ordinary photographs, not a depiction of temporary renovation works.
